items.why: Bitcoin slid with the broader risk off tape as climbing bond yields and a pullback from record highs in equities weighed on risk assets. No single crypto headline; it moved with the market.
Meta gave back part of its recent AI driven rally as the market retreated from records. Wells Fargo raised its price target to $1,000 today but warned of a 2027 earnings trough.
Gold pulled back as Treasury yields climbed, lifting the opportunity cost of holding the metal. Part of a broad commodities fade even with oil prices still running hot.
Small caps underperformed in the broad pullback from records as bond market jitters and climbing yields hit rate sensitive corners of the market hardest.

market_note: Index futures softer after hours across the board; traders looking ahead to the FOMC minutes.
summary: Stocks retreated from record highs as climbing Treasury yields and hot oil prices put the record rally on pause. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed lower, with Bitcoin and small caps among the weakest spots in a broad risk off session.
